info.title: PaySubscriptions API
info.description: Versioned REST API for User-owned resources. This hand-written document covers the resources not yet migrated to API Platform; ExpenseCategory (/expense-categories) and Subscription (/subscriptions) are served by API Platform and described by its generated document (/api/docs.jsonopenapi). It covers the dashboard snapshot report (issue #99), a read-only endpoint to which write-error statuses 409/422 do not apply. Additive backward-compatible changes stay within v1; breaking changes require a new version.

get.summary: Current dashboard snapshot: summary cards plus one chart mode
get.description: Stateless snapshot of the authenticated User's Subscriptions reusing the web dashboard calculations. Summary mirrors SubscriptionService::getTotals() plus the User limit; chart series mirror ChartService numeric data with basis/visibility metadata instead of Chart.js options. Pending-review cross-currency Subscriptions stay in counts but are excluded from monetary totals and charts. The month selector applies only to the monthly direct view (monthly Subscriptions plus yearly ones whose next-payment month matches). No year, date-range, payment-history, or forecast semantics.

parameters.name: chartMode
parameters.description: Chart view: twelve-month charge distribution (bar), monthly doughnut (monthly), or yearly doughnut (yearly). Defaults to bar.

parameters.name: basis
parameters.description: Direct-cycle charges (direct) or normalized equivalents (equivalent). The bar view supports direct only; monthly equivalent uses per-Subscription monthly calculations over all reportable Subscriptions; yearly equivalent uses yearly calculations. Defaults to direct.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Optional User-owned ExpenseCategory UUID filter; omit for all categories. Unknown, malformed, or foreign IDs return 404 without disclosing another User's data.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month of the year (1-12) used only by the monthly direct view. Any other use, or a value outside 1-12, returns 422.

200.description: Summary cards, numeric chart data with visibility metadata, and the applied filters.

paySubsOAuth2.description: User-delegated authorization code with S256 PKCE. Manually registered clients only; explicit scope api:full; 15-minute access tokens issued by this server.

scopes.api:full: Full read/write access to the approving User's data.

summary.description: Summary-card values from SubscriptionService::getTotals() plus the User limit. Pending-review cross-currency Subscriptions are counted but excluded from monetary fields.

monthly.description: Direct monthly-cycle total in the main currency.

yearly.description: Direct yearly-cycle total in the main currency.

monthlyEquivalent.description: Normalized monthly total (direct monthly plus yearly divided by 12).

yearlyEquivalent.description: Normalized yearly total (direct yearly plus monthly multiplied by 12).

count.description: Subscription count within the report (after the category filter), including pending-review items. The account-wide total compared against limit is not exposed here.

limit.description: User subscription limit (account-wide, independent of the category filter).

currency.description: Main-currency label, or null when no main currency is confirmed.

chart.description: Numeric chart data with visibility metadata. Bar mode carries per-month labels and per-Subscription datasets; monthly/yearly modes carry parallel labels and values. No Chart.js styling or options are exposed.

basis.description: Bar always reports per-month charges; doughnut modes report direct-cycle or normalized-equivalent values.

currency.description: Main-currency label, or null when no main currency is confirmed.

labels.description: Month names for bar mode, Subscription names for monthly/yearly modes.

datasets.description: Bar mode only: one numeric twelve-value series per reportable Subscription.

data.description: Monthly/yearly modes only: values parallel to labels.

empty.description: True when the active view draws no series.

hiddenCount.description: Reportable Subscriptions excluded by the direct-cycle view.

hiddenCycle.description: Billing cycle hidden by the direct view, or null when nothing is hidden.

detail.description: Safe human-readable detail; never leaks another User's data.

errors.description: Field-level violations for 422 responses (report filters and write operations).

Forbidden.description: Valid token without api:full scope, unapproved client, or ineligible account.

CategoryNotFound.description: Missing, malformed, or foreign category ID.

InvalidFilter.description: Invalid report filter: unknown chart mode or basis, misplaced or out-of-range month, or equivalent basis with the bar view. Carries code invalid_filter with field-level errors.
